messages.content:
You are assessing claims to advise a decision in a fictional case. Use only the supplied case material. The task is to determine what the records establish about each candidate claim, then give a brief decision note.

For each claim, return status, confidence, and citations. Status is "supported" if the available records establish the claim, "contradicted" if they establish its negation, or "unresolved" if they do neither. Confidence is your integer estimate from 0 to 100 of whether the claim itself is true, not your confidence in the status label. Limited evidence can inform that number without establishing the claim. Cite exact source IDs for evidence that establishes the claim or its negation. Use an empty list if no decisive source ID is available. Do not invent identifiers. A handoff may summarize record material. A follow-up is a new source when present. In your note, briefly distinguish decisive evidence from provisional indications.

Prepare the first assessment of the original records for a possible handoff.

{"scenario":"Copper Reed trial","question":"Can extension staff cite a field sample as meeting the wetness target?","claims":{"A":"Plot W was in the centre of the block.","B":"Plot W was sampled at noon.","C":"Plot W was below the moisture target when sampled at noon."},"sources":{"S1":"a plot supervisor saw a dry upper surface and reported likely low moisture, but the sampling procedure measures deeper soil.","S2":"field map marks W as the outside plot.","S3":"signed collection tag records Plot W sampled at noon."}}

message.content: {"claims":{"A":{"status":"contradicted","citations":["S2"],"confidence":90},"B":{"status":"supported","citations":["S3"],"confidence":95},"C":{"status":"unresolved","citations":[],"confidence":40}},"note":"Claim A is contradicted by S2, which shows Plot W as an outside plot, not in the center. Claim B is supported by S3, the signed collection tag recording Plot W sampled at noon. Claim C is unresolved; S1 indicates a dry upper surface and likely low moisture but notes the sampling measures deeper soil, so it does not establish that Plot W was below the moisture target at noon."}

Claim C is unresolved; S1 indicates a dry upper surface and likely low moisture but notes the sampling measures deeper soil, so it does not establish that Plot W was below the moisture target at noon.
